title: Hybrid quantum learning for imbalanced blood-cell classification: domain adaptation and classifier design
abstract: arXiv:2611.18757v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Limited annotated data, class imbalance, and morphological similarity make white blood cell classification challenging. We benchmark hybrid variational quantum classifier heads against an affine baseline on 821 microscopy images across seven morphological classes. Using ImageNet-initialised ResNet34 backbones and repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation, we first compare direct transfer with intermediate adaptation on MLL23, a larger peripheral blood cell microscopy dataset. To guide the head comparison, we explore different encoding strategies, variational depth, and the number of independent circuit blocks. We then compare the classifier performance using the affine head and two hybrid heads across multiple random seeds, under a shared training and evaluation protocol. translated_title: 面向不平衡血液细胞分类的混合量子学习：域适应与分类器设计
translated_abstract: 标注数据有限、类别不平衡以及形态相似性使得白细胞分类具有挑战性。我们在涵盖七个形态学类别的821张显微图像上，将混合变分量子分类器头与仿射基线进行了基准对比。使用ImageNet预初始化的ResNet34骨干网络和重复分层五折交叉验证，我们首先比较了直接迁移与在MLL23（一个更大的外周血细胞显微图像数据集）上进行中间域适应的效果。为了指导分类器头的比较，我们探索了不同的编码策略、变分深度以及独立量子线路块的数量。随后，在共享的训练与评估协议下，我们使用仿射分类器头和两个混合分类器头，在多个随机种子下比较了分类器性能。在此比较中，所有骨干网络均共享相同的MLL23适应初始化。中间域适应提高了所有四个仿射分类器头微调的平均宏F1分数……
tldr: 该论文针对类别不平衡的白细胞分类任务，通过在更大的MLL23数据集上进行中间域适应来提升迁移学习效果，并系统地对比了混合变分量子分类器头与仿射基线在不同编码策略和线路深度下的性能表现。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks hybrid variational quantum classifier heads against an affine baseline for imbalanced white blood cell classification, demonstrating that intermediate domain adaptation on a larger peripheral blood cell dataset improves transfer performance across encoding strategies and circuit depths.
